d:
Amerika daure par gae rahul gandhi ne kolanbiya aur shikago yunivarsiti men chhatron aur shikshavidon se batchit ki. is dauran unhonne bhartiy arthavyavastha, berozgari, chunavi vyavastha aur israil-gaza par bharat ke rukh ko lekar apni ray rakhi.
Rahul gandhi ne bharat ko aarthik aapda ki kagar par bataya aur chunavi prakriya par saval uthate hue kaha ki vipaksh chunav larna band nahin kar sakta, kyonki isse loktantr ki vaidhta khatm ho jaegi. unke bayanon par bijepi ne palatvar kiya.
Is vidiyo men janie amerika men rahul gandhi ne kya kaha aur bijepi ne unke aaropon par kya javab diya.
